desc: The Aether rifle is currently made on our GHOST lowers which we spend the extra time to engrave the serial number on the bottom side of the lower to leave a sleek clean blank finish on the sides to customize to your liking. Our barrels are produced from raw bar stock to finished product at a single state of the art facility. We drill, ream, rifle, contour, and assemble, using the latest in robot automation technology. All of our barrels are properly stress relieved after rifling, and extensions are torqued after nitride. Our quality control system ensures that all barrels are dimensionally correct and bores fall well within their individual tolerance.
